title: PANTHEON belongs on your radar
description:
This repo should be on your radar: 94BILLY/PANTHEON. PANTHEON: A deterministic Path 1 rendering framework for the PlayStation 2. Sustaining a locked 60 FPS baseline, it leverages the Emotion Engine as a high-bandwidth stream orchestrator to sequence DMA/VIF command chains to the VU1 co-processor. Extracts maximum silicon throughput via direct XGKICK hardware rendering. It has about 3 GitHub stars, and it is active enough to deserve a closer look. Save this for your next build, and follow for more useful developer tools.

https://github.com/94BILLY/PANTHEON

#GitHub #OpenSource #Developer #Programming #Shorts
